description: Ministry of Education - Order made under Section 27(1) Department of Information Technology University of Colombo, Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content involves a legal/regulatory amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under specific sections of the Act (Section 27(1), Section 21, and Section 139) that amends the organizational structure of the University of Colombo by adding a new Department of Information Technology. While it mentions Minister Dinesh Gunawardena, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title, and the primary focus is on regulatory amendment rather than government personnel or structural changes.
